value.a: FAILOVER, NOT PARTNER: the deterministic layer answers most questions free and testably; Hex fires on the miss and its output is labeled `read`. The learning lands in the deterministic layer, so competence survives model swaps — CC's and Hex's.

PROVENANCE AS A REQUIRED FIELD: every scan carries the dated correction that seeded it, and tooth 12 refuses a scan without one (and a scan that joins the registry without joining the teeth). force-the-why-structurally, applied to the learning device itself.

THE INSTRUMENT CORRECTED ITS COMMISSIONING MEASUREMENT: CC's grep an hour earlier said 7 emit() call sites; the AST scan measures 4 outside proofs (charter, harbor_master, sudo_relay, system_rackmount — and zero in bus stands). The tool's first act was to fix the number it was justified by.

THE CENSUS FLAGGED ITS OWN BUILDER: first real run reported orient charter_on_disk:False — the charter was written because the instrument refused its absence. A hollow build could not have produced that complaint.

VALIDATION FILES ARE LISTS EVERYWHERE (append-only) — found when the census met the real tree; CC's dict fixture was the wrong shape, and the fix (latest-verdict + record count) is itself a measured-shape note in the scan.
